question: 2025年各订单状态下，实付金额高于5000元的高金额订单数与5000元及以下的普通订单数分别是多少？（含取消订单的结构统计）
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(CASE WHEN total_amount > 5000 AND status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS high_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN total_amount <= 5000 AND status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS normal_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
pred_sql: SELECT status, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_amount_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount <= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_amount_orders FROM orders GROUP BY status
initial_sql: SELECT status, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_amount_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount <= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_amount_orders FROM orders GROUP BY status
final_sql: SELECT status, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_amount_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount <= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_amount_orders FROM orders GROUP BY status
